title: Heavy Weighted Blanket Doesn’t Work as Throw
text:
Heavy Weighted Blanket Doesn’t Work as Throw. This TRU LITE BEDDING TRU BLANKET (Weighted; Happiness Embroidery; 60"x 80"; 15 lbs, Gray) is pretty, but it does NOT work as a throw. It’s far too heavy to wrangle around for snuggling up inside it. Fifteen pounds may not sound like much, but it’s a lot to deal with in a blanket that’s large enough to cover a regular double bed.

In my opinion, the weighting is a gimmick. It is true that when you’re underneath this blanket, you feel very warm and protected. However, you can get the same effect from several layers of bedding (combining blankets, comforter, heavy bedspread, etc.).

I can’t imagine this being acceptable to a couple sharing a bed, unless one person is an incorrigible “bedclothes hog”. The weight is the problem--it restricts bed mobility. For that reason, this blanket is a terrible choice for an elderly or disabled person. It makes it very difficult to turn over and change positions at night.

The blanket is quite well made, with the word “Happiness” embroidered on the underside of the silky “slipcover” for the weighted, quilted interior blanket portion. The appearance of the slipcover is a bit misleading--the textured polka dots are part of the weave of the fabric, and do NOT have anything to do with the weighting. (For some reason, I thought that the dots indicated little round weights.)

If you’re young, healthy, and strong, and dislike extra layers of bedclothes, then you’ll probably love this blanket for its “swaddling” effect. If you’re elderly or disabled, you probably won’t be able to use this blanket at all.

features: Luxury Blanket Set - 100% cotton in a premium 400 thread count weave. Diamond quilted inner blanket feels smooth and cool to the touch. For warmer weather, zip on machine washable plush minky duvet and snuggle up!

Tiny Glass Beads - weight comes from non-toxic beads which are smaller than poly or plastic pellets. Glass beads do not off-gas or have odors. No crunchy noises or "bean bag" feel - just a comfortably heavy blanket to relax under.

Happiness & Sweet Dreams - sleep soundly under the heavy weight. The sensation of extra pressure creates a sense of calm and relaxation for adults and children, helping you to chill out. Gorgeous "Happiness" embroidery on the corner of the duvet.

Superior Quality - 12 ties keep blanket secure inside duvet. Small, diamond pattern quilting is double reinforced keeping weight from shifting and bunching. Tactile dots for fidgeting or sensory input.

Perfect Size - 60"x80" 15lb blanket works well for bed use or as a throw to use on your lap, mattress or sofa. Perfect for adults or older children and teens. CAUTION: do not use with children under 5 years old.
